title: Wrillustrations: everything is hand-drawn, nav included
note: An illustrator's site where the logo, the nav, the social icons and every caption are hand-lettered PNGs. Work sits on white at slightly different sizes, like things laid on a table, each with a handwritten title (THE KING'S CAKE, SKIN, GIGS!). Almost no animation. Worth taking: you can't generate this, because every mark is hers.
